concept: Ollama default 262144 context and num_ctx memory cost on Mac
summary: Ollama docs: "Tasks which require large context like web search, agents, and coding tools should be set to at least 64000 tokens."

facts.text: Ollama docs: "Tasks which require large context like web search, agents, and coding tools should be set to at least 64000 tokens."
Ollama docs: cloud models are set to their maximum context length by default.
Ollama docs example: `ollama ps` columns are NAME, ID, SIZE, PROCESSOR, CONTEXT, UNTIL, e.g. gemma4:latest 9.6 GB, 100% GPU, context 131072.
Ollama docs advise using the model's maximum context for best performance while keeping PROCESSOR at 100% GPU (no CPU offload).
Per-token KV cost differs by model: a maintainer measured 32k context at 6.2 GB for phi4:14b and 12 GB for gemma3:12b (gemma3 also needs memory for its image projector).
A maintainer showed OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=3 turned a 128000 request into --ctx-size 384000, needing 181.6 GiB KV and leaving only 12 of 63 layers on GPU.
Changing num_ctx causes a model reload, which is why the first request after a change is slow.
If a model is sharded across several devices the VRAM needed rises because each device runs a copy of the compute graph.
